summary: MakeMyTrip Ltd filed a Form 6-K on August 7, 2026, announcing its upcoming annual meeting of shareholders scheduled for September 28, 2026, in Gurugram, India. The filing includes the notice of annual meeting, form of proxy, and audited consolidated and separate financial statements for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, prepared by KPMG (Mauritius). This is a routine disclosure of meeting logistics and statutory financial reporting under Mauritius requirements. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, restructuring, or management change is indicated. The filing is purely administrative and procedural, with no deal terms or strategic actions involved.
